cards.card_text: The Jews say they're not stoning Jesus for any good work, but for ___.
cards.verse_text: “We are not stoning You for any good work,” said the Jews, “but for blasphemy, because You, who are a man, make Yourself out to be God.”

cards.card_text: And while they're stoning him, Stephen calls out to the Lord.
cards.verse_text: While they were stoning him, Stephen appealed, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.”
